source.title: European Society of Gynaecological Oncology guidelines for the management of patients with vulvar cancer - update 2023.

whyItFits: Vulvar cancer is grounded in the 2023 ESGO guideline. Vaginal cancer is grounded in the open 2025 FIGO update.
limitations: Vulvar recommendations are from the open ESGO 2023 guideline. Vaginal-cancer recommendations are from the open FIGO 2025 update (PMC12411808). The ESGO pocket PDF was not stored.
